IgA is an antibody that helps your body fight infections.
You said you get colds more often than usual, and they last longer.
You don't have other infections or stomach problems.
Your family is generally healthy, and there's no known history of immune issues.
Your low IgA level might be related to your symptoms, but we didn't find any specific diagnosis or health problem during this visit.
